events.title: NHL Hockey - Colorado Avalanche at Calgary Flames
events.description: The Calgary Flames and the Colorado Avalanche meet for a regular-season series opener at Scotiabank Saddledome. Nathan MacKinnon leads the Avalanche in points and assists, while the Flames rely on Joel Farabee who also leads in points and assists. (Hockey) - 2026-10-08
